name: Diabetes
overview: Scripture acknowledges the importance of God's provision for health and well-being, promising that serving the Lord brings blessings and the removal of sickness (Exodus 23:25). It also provides guidance on dietary practices, emphasizing moderation and caution, such as avoiding excess consumption of sweet foods like honey to prevent harm (Proverbs 25:16) and adhering to specific food laws (Leviticus 3:17). These principles encourage believers to trust God’s sovereignty (Psalms 46:10) while exercising wisdom and self-control in caring for their bodies, which are temples of the Holy Spirit.
